# MediFinder India

> MediFinder India is an early-stage (2026) platform that connects customers with licensed pharmacies, labs, nurses, ambulance providers and delivery partners. Tagline: Search • Connect • Care. Message: Your health in safe hands.

## Key facts
- Founder and Grievance Redressal Officer: Rejoyan Sarkar
- Website: https://medifinderindia.com/
- Email: support@medifinderindia.com
- Phone: +91 9593625498
- Address: Banihari, Janchi, Gangarampur, Dakshin Dinajpur, West Bengal 733140
- Udyam Registration No.: UDYAM-WB-19-0037143 (Ministry of MSME, Government of India)
- Date of commencement: 13/06/2026
- Service area: West Bengal

## What MediFinder India is
- A connector/marketplace platform: it connects customers with licensed partner providers.
- Medicines are supplied and dispensed by licensed partner pharmacies, not by MediFinder India.
- Services: medicine delivery, lab tests and sample collection, home nurse, ambulance, and delivery by partner riders.
- Payments: UPI, card, or cash on delivery (COD).

## What MediFinder India is NOT
- It does not run its own pharmacy or medicine shop.
- It does not give medical advice.
- Udyam Registration is a business registration. It is NOT a Drug Licence.

## Name
- Official name: MediFinder India (also written MediFinder or medifinderindia.com).
